title: Accessibility Audit codebase eval
objective: Measure whether the audit finds concrete WCAG failures across a seeded UI and leaves a source-cited remediation report.
prompt: Use the Accessibility Audit craftbook for a whole-codebase maintenance pass. Review the seeded UI against WCAG 2.1 AA and write tasks/eval/a11y-report.md. Do not change the UI.

setup.about: A tiny dashboard UI with deliberate accessibility defects. Source files are authoritative and no network access is needed.
setup.missionObjectives: Find the seeded keyboard, labeling, semantic, image-text, and contrast defects; cite real files/elements and propose exact fixes in tasks/eval/a11y-report.md.

success.summary: tasks/eval/a11y-report.md cites the seeded UI and covers every deliberate WCAG failure with a concrete fix.

axes.name: coverage
axes.description: The seeded WCAG failures and passing/unknown criteria are accounted for.

axes.name: evidence
axes.description: Findings cite concrete elements, source paths, and measured values.

axes.name: remediation
axes.description: Each issue includes a specific code-level fix.
